issues.title: Missing Verifies clauses for AC-09
issues.why: AC-09 (Boolean Storage) is marked as a critical normative contract but lacks the 'Verifies' clause required by the module's own changelog standards (v3.3.2) and rubric.
issues.fix: Add 'Verifies: the cross-language storage contract preventing data corruption' to AC-09 in 97-acceptance-criteria.md.

issues.title: Broken link to 07-split-db-pattern.md
issues.why: The overview index and quick reference link to 07-split-db-pattern.md, but the changelog (v3.4.2) and drift acknowledgment note a naming conflict with 07-split-db-architecture.md.
issues.fix: Rename 07-split-db-pattern.md to 07-split-db-architecture.md and update all internal references to match.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency Specification
issues.why: The spec explicitly offloads concurrency (WAL mode, retries, locking) to spec/13, but spec/13 is not provided in this context, leaving the AI to guess SQLite's multi-writer behavior.
issues.fix: Inline the mandatory SQLite PRAGMAs (WAL, busy_timeout) and 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' requirement into 02-schema-design.md §4.3.
